title: Instrument register
description: Validates reference/instrument_register.yaml: every instrument's identity and source identifiers (ADR-004). Each fact that can change is a list of versions, newest last, so the register is point in time.

instruments.description: Instruments keyed by permanent code, assigned once and never changed or reused. FX codes are FX.<base><quote> in ISO 4217; other asset-class patterns are added with their first instrument.

valid_from_date.description: First date the fact holds, ISO date, quoted so YAML keeps it a string.

recorded_date.description: Date the fact was written to the register, ISO date, quoted so YAML keeps it a string.

instrument.description: One instrument: its attribute versions and its source identifiers.

versions.description: Attribute versions, insert-only, in ascending valid_from_date order (newest last).

source_ids.description: Identifier map: one entry per source and version, in ascending valid_from_date order (newest last).

version.description: The instrument's attributes from valid_from_date on.

current_symbol.description: Symbol shown today; FX: base and quote currency without separator, for example EURPLN.

exchange.description: MIC of the listing exchange; FX pairs have none.

quote_ccy.description: Currency of the price, ISO 4217; 'currency' in ADR-004.

source_id.description: The identifier one source uses for the instrument from valid_from_date on.

source.description: Source name, as in its source config (config/sources/<source>.yaml).

source_instrument_id.description: The source's own identifier; NBP: table and code, as in /api/exchangerates/rates/A/EUR/.
